event_detail: The robot has set the pot (not a task object) down on the left burner, crowding the kettle that was already there and pushing it toward the back of the burner; it then goes back to the left burner knob.
evidence: At 46.4 s the pot sits on the left burner area, pressed against the kettle; the kettle is upright behind it, and a blue flame shows at the left edge of the burner. From 48.0 to 51.2 s the arm leaves the pot and moves to the front-left knob. At 48.0 s the wrist camera shows the knob indicator in a turned position, and at 49.6-51.2 s the gripper is right over that knob. At 51.2 s the kettle is still upright on the cooktop at the back of the left burner, behind the pot, and blue flame is still visible at the left of the burner. So both stages appear to hold, but the kettle is no longer clearly centred on the burner, and the robot is handling the knob again, which could switch the burner off. Ambiguous: the pot and arm hide most of the burner, so how much of the kettle is still over the flame is uncertain.
